too... I'm on absolute cloud nine right 
now!

Yes! Everyone in the stands, and everyone 
back home too...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dad was just on the phone earlier, saying 
they were all about to raise a celebratory 
toast!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, you're right! Can't let the 
results go to our heads!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone who supports me, 
I can't afford to look uncool.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I have to work harder and harder so I can 
keep bringing smiles to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Kitasan Black is gonna keep getting 
stronger and stronger!
